content:
Clari is an asset for companies that want better access to their pipeline with accurate forecasting. This revenue tool helps them make better decisions. While many focus on managing customer information, it helps you understand your current revenue picture and where it will go in the future. 

But for growing businesses, forecasting is difficult because their data is not in a single system or under a single team. Here's where Clari brings all the data together so revenue leaders can do their work and companies can benefit from this tool's features.

How Clari Works?

Revenue generation involves many steps, including pipeline creation and forecasting. For each step, Clari provides a central view for revenue operations. 

The phases include: 

  • Forecast revenue 
  • Manage pipeline 
  • Revenue intelligence 
  • Deal Inspection 
  • AI-based analytics 

With all these features,, it gives businesses confidence in their revenue forecasts. You can also see pipeline performance and risks before they occur. So, it lets businesses make effective decisions and strengthen accountability for revenue teams. 

Instead of relying on spreadsheets or manual work, businesses gain live insights. This helps teams understand the detailed business process and can work as per it.

Core Capabilities Powering Clari

Revenue Forecasting

It assesses pipeline activity, deal movement, and past performance. Accordingly, Clari enables companies to create forecasts based on data rather than guesswork. 

Pipeline Management

You can identify opportunities at every stage of the sales process. Accordingly, you will know how the deals are progressing and where you have to pay attention. 

Revenue Intelligence

Clari converts a large volume of revenue data into insights that sales leaders, RevOps teams, and other decision-makers use to inform decision-making.

Deal Inspection

With it, teams can see every opportunity in detail. And this will help them identify risks, stalled deals, and missing engagement before losses.

AI-Based Insights

AI finds patterns that you cannot readily see and shows the areas where you want to pay attention.

What Makes Clari Stand Out?

  • Focuses greatly on revenue predictability 
  • Gives detailed insights into pipeline performance
  • AI-based insights for better decision-making 
  • Aligns sales, revenue, operations, and leadership teams
  • Decreases dependence on spreadsheets and manual reporting

Companies adopt Clari because it gives teams a clear picture of revenue performance. And they don't have to make random guesses yet see future outcomes.

Key Services Offered by Clari

  • Revenue Forecasting: Clari provides tools that help companies improve forecasting and planning.
  • Pipeline Management: It lets you see pipeline activity. And teams then use it to understand where they have to pay attention. 
  • Revenue Intelligence: This tool converts revenue data to actionable insights. 
  • Deal Inspection: The tool lets managers assess the health of opportunities and potential challenges before they affect results. 
  • Revenue Operations Support: You benefit from a unified view of revenue activity. In turn, it improves team collaboration. 
  • AI-Driven Analytics: It shows predictive insights to understand trends, risks, and opportunities.

Who Should Work with Clari?

Clari helps various sectors with its revenue-based features. In my opinion, wiser companies in these industries do use Clari to get better sales. 

  • Revenue Teams: They use the tool to improve forecasting. Together with pipeline visibility, they can manage complex sales cycles better. 
  • RevOps Teams: If you need more unified reporting to improve planning and forecasting, Clari can help. 
  • Executive Leadership: Those who want predictable revenue outcomes and strong business visibility choose it. But you need some trust, and it gives you confidence in decision-making and forecasts. 
  • Technology and SaaS: With Clari, companies can manage recurring revenue models, large pipelines, and achieve fast growth. 
  • Financial Services: Teams benefit from better forecasting and revenue planning.

Pros

  • Dependable forecasting skills 
  • Good pipeline visibility 
  • AI-based revenue insights
  • Aligns revenue teams 
  • Improves forecasting confidence

Considerations

  • Gives the best value when multiple teams adopt it. 
  • Can be a large investment as compared to basic forecasting tools

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • Gong: It is a reliable revenue intelligence tool.
  • Salesforce: Helps with efficient forecasting and analytics.
  • BoostUp: This is a RevOps and forecasting tool.
  • InsightSquared: Sales analytics platform.
  • People.ai provides pipeline visibility and is a revenue intelligence platform.

Takeaway

Clari is popular with companies that focus on revenue. This is because it helps them understand future revenue and ways to improve it. It has forecasting, pipeline visibility, revenue intelligence, and AI-based insights in a single place. So, your company can make decisions logically rather than guess. And if you want better revenue predictability and planning, then it also helps. 

So do you want greater visibility of your revenue pipeline with better forecasting confidence? If yes, then check how Clari is an asset!

Frequently Ask Questions

What does Clari specialize in?

It helps with revenue forecasting, pipeline management, revenue intelligence, and RevOps visibility.

Is Clari only suitable for large enterprises?

Many companies use Clari. Also, medium-scale businesses with better sales and revenue processes benefit from it.

Does Clari use artificial intelligence?

Yes, it has AI-based insights that identify revenue risks, find trends, and improve forecasting accuracy.

What industries commonly use Clari?

Technology, SaaS, financial services, healthcare technology, telecommunications, and business services benefit from it.

How does Clari improve forecasting accuracy?

With better analysis of pipeline activity, progression, engagement signals, and past performance data, it excels in reliable forecasting.
